title: All Disco, All Dan
tagline: Four clubs, twelve stages and one night to light up every disc!
blurb: Four clubs, twelve stages and one night to light up every disc! Hop Dan on the beat to pump up the multiplier, fill the Funk Meter and let rip a Boogie Point to freeze Ron the bouncer and Flat-Note Fred. Dodge the spotlight, beat the cassette counter or chill at your own pace, and dance all the way to the Starlight Rooftop.
